# Verification plan: irq_ctrl
# Serves project requirement req-5fc7831312: "Verify the existing interrupt controller RTL."
# Source specification: interface_spec.md (approved interface_spec).
# This plan is a statement of intent. Nothing listed here has run or been verified.
# Requirement text below is quoted from interface_spec.md without the [req:...] tag.

spec: "interface_spec.md"
block: "irq_ctrl"
project_requirement: "req-5fc7831312"

requirements:
  - id: "IRQ-PARAM"
    source: "interface_spec.md"
    text: "The block works for every `N` from 2 to 32, and bits `N` and up of the `ENABLE`, `MODE` and `PENDING` registers read as zero and ignore writes."
  - id: "IRQ-RESET"
    source: "interface_spec.md"
    text: "While `rst_n` is low at a rising edge of `clk`, `ENABLE`, `MODE` and `PENDING` clear to zero and the remembered level of every source clears to zero."
  - id: "IRQ-REG-RW"
    source: "interface_spec.md"
    text: "A write to `ENABLE` or `MODE` stores `wdata` bits `N-1` to 0 in that register."
  - id: "IRQ-READ"
    source: "interface_spec.md"
    text: "A read never changes any register; `rdata` follows `addr` with no clock edge."
  - id: "IRQ-LEVEL"
    source: "interface_spec.md"
    text: "A high-level source sets its `PENDING` bit at every rising edge where its input is high."
  - id: "IRQ-EDGE"
    source: "interface_spec.md"
    text: "A rising-edge source sets its `PENDING` bit at a rising edge where its input is high and was low at the previous rising edge, so an input held high sets it once."
  - id: "IRQ-DETECT-DISABLED"
    source: "interface_spec.md"
    text: "Detection does not depend on `ENABLE`: a disabled source still sets its `PENDING` bit."
  - id: "IRQ-W1C"
    source: "interface_spec.md"
    text: "A write to `PENDING` clears each bit written 1 and leaves each bit written 0 unchanged; it never sets a bit."
  - id: "IRQ-ACK"
    source: "interface_spec.md"
    text: "A write to `CLAIM` acknowledges the source whose number is in `wdata` bits 4 to 0: that source's `PENDING` bit clears and no other bit changes; a number of `N` or more changes nothing."
  - id: "IRQ-SET-WINS"
    source: "interface_spec.md"
    text: "A source detected at the same rising edge as a write that clears its bit keeps its `PENDING` bit set, so a high-level source acknowledged while its input is still high stays pending."
  - id: "IRQ-MASK"
    source: "interface_spec.md"
    text: "`irq` is high exactly when some source has both its `PENDING` and its `ENABLE` bit set, for high-level and rising-edge sources alike."
  - id: "IRQ-PRIORITY"
    source: "interface_spec.md"
    text: "`irq_id` is the lowest-numbered source whose `PENDING` and `ENABLE` bits are both set, so source 0 has the highest priority, and it is 0 while `irq` is low."
  - id: "IRQ-CLAIM"
    source: "interface_spec.md"
    text: "A read of `CLAIM` returns `irq` in bit 31 and `irq_id` in bits 4 to 0, with every other bit zero."
  - id: "IRQ-LATENCY"
    source: "interface_spec.md"
    text: "`irq` and `irq_id` follow the registers with no clock edge, so a source detected at one rising edge drives `irq` until the next."

items:
  # ---------------- Directed tests (irq_ctrl_tb.sv) ----------------
  - id: "T-PARAM"
    kind: "test"
    name: "test_param_upper_bits"
    file: "irq_ctrl_tb.sv"
    proves: ["IRQ-PARAM"]
    description: "Goal: upper register bits are inert for every N. Stimulus: build at N=2, N=8 and N=32; write all ones to ENABLE, MODE and PENDING; drive src with all ones. Check: bits N to 31 of ENABLE, MODE and PENDING read 0; bits below N behave as the other tests require."
  - id: "T-RESET"
    kind: "test"
    name: "test_reset"
    file: "irq_ctrl_tb.sv"
    proves: ["IRQ-RESET"]
    description: "Goal: reset clears state. Stimulus: set ENABLE, MODE and PENDING non-zero and hold rising-edge sources high; assert rst_n low for one edge; release with those sources still high. Check: ENABLE, MODE, PENDING read 0 after reset; the next edge with a rising-edge source still high sets PENDING (remembered level was cleared to 0)."
  - id: "T-REG-RW"
    kind: "test"
    name: "test_reg_rw"
    file: "irq_ctrl_tb.sv"
    proves: ["IRQ-REG-RW"]
    description: "Goal: ENABLE and MODE store written data. Stimulus: write walking-one, walking-zero and random patterns to addr 0 and addr 1. Check: each read returns wdata bits N-1 to 0 of the last write to that register, and the other register is unchanged."
  - id: "T-READ"
    kind: "test"
    name: "test_read_no_side_effect"
    file: "irq_ctrl_tb.sv"
    proves: ["IRQ-READ"]
    description: "Goal: reads are side-effect free and combinational. Stimulus: with we low, sweep addr through 0 to 3 several times within cycles, including reads of PENDING and CLAIM while sources are pending. Check: rdata matches the selected register in the same cycle addr changes; no register changes across the reads."
  - id: "T-LEVEL"
    kind: "test"
    name: "test_level_detect"
    file: "irq_ctrl_tb.sv"
    proves: ["IRQ-LEVEL"]
    description: "Goal: high-level detection. Stimulus: MODE bit 0; pulse src high for one edge, then hold high while clearing PENDING each cycle. Check: PENDING bit sets after each edge where src is high, and is set again after every clear while src stays high."
  - id: "T-EDGE"
    kind: "test"
    name: "test_edge_detect"
    file: "irq_ctrl_tb.sv"
    proves: ["IRQ-EDGE"]
    description: "Goal: rising-edge detection. Stimulus: MODE bit 1; raise src and hold it high for many cycles, clear PENDING while it stays high, then drop and raise it again. Check: PENDING sets once on the low-to-high edge, stays clear after clearing while src remains high, and sets again on the next low-to-high transition."
  - id: "T-DETECT-DISABLED"
    kind: "test"
    name: "test_detect_disabled"
    file: "irq_ctrl_tb.sv"
    proves: ["IRQ-DETECT-DISABLED"]
    description: "Goal: detection ignores ENABLE. Stimulus: ENABLE all zero; trigger level and edge sources. Check: PENDING bits set while irq stays low; enabling a source afterwards raises irq."
  - id: "T-W1C"
    kind: "test"
    name: "test_pending_w1c"
    file: "irq_ctrl_tb.sv"
    proves: ["IRQ-W1C"]
    description: "Goal: PENDING is write-1-to-clear. Stimulus: set several PENDING bits with sources then idle; write patterns of ones and zeros to addr 2, including all zeros and bits for sources that are not pending. Check: bits written 1 clear, bits written 0 keep their value, and no bit that was 0 becomes 1 from the write."
  - id: "T-ACK"
    kind: "test"
    name: "test_claim_ack"
    file: "irq_ctrl_tb.sv"
    proves: ["IRQ-ACK"]
    description: "Goal: CLAIM write acknowledges one source. Stimulus: several sources pending, inputs idle; write each source number to addr 3, with junk in wdata bits 31 to 5; write numbers N to 31. Check: only the named source's PENDING bit clears; numbers N or more leave PENDING unchanged."
  - id: "T-SET-WINS"
    kind: "test"
    name: "test_set_wins"
    file: "irq_ctrl_tb.sv"
    proves: ["IRQ-SET-WINS"]
    description: "Goal: same-edge set beats clear. Stimulus: high-level source with input held high, acknowledged by CLAIM write and cleared by PENDING write; rising-edge source whose low-to-high edge lands on the clearing write's edge. Check: the PENDING bit is set after that edge in every case, and irq stays high if enabled."
  - id: "T-MASK"
    kind: "test"
    name: "test_irq_mask"
    file: "irq_ctrl_tb.sv"
    proves: ["IRQ-MASK"]
    description: "Goal: irq is PENDING AND ENABLE reduced. Stimulus: for level and edge sources, step through combinations of pending and enabled across sources, toggling ENABLE with PENDING fixed and vice versa. Check: irq equals OR over sources of (PENDING and ENABLE) every cycle."
  - id: "T-PRIORITY"
    kind: "test"
    name: "test_priority"
    file: "irq_ctrl_tb.sv"
    proves: ["IRQ-PRIORITY"]
    description: "Goal: lowest-numbered enabled pending source wins. Stimulus: random and directed sets of pending and enabled sources, including source 0, source N-1 alone, and a pending but disabled lower source; acknowledge the winner repeatedly. Check: irq_id equals the lowest index with both bits set; irq_id is 0 whenever irq is low."
  - id: "T-CLAIM"
    kind: "test"
    name: "test_claim_read"
    file: "irq_ctrl_tb.sv"
    proves: ["IRQ-CLAIM"]
    description: "Goal: CLAIM read layout. Stimulus: read addr 3 with irq low and with each source as winner. Check: rdata bit 31 equals irq, bits 4 to 0 equal irq_id, bits 30 to 5 are zero."
  - id: "T-LATENCY"
    kind: "test"
    name: "test_latency"
    file: "irq_ctrl_tb.sv"
    proves: ["IRQ-LATENCY"]
    description: "Goal: irq and irq_id are combinational from the registers. Stimulus: trigger an enabled source at one edge; separately change ENABLE by a write. Check: irq and irq_id reflect the new PENDING or ENABLE value in the cycle right after the updating edge, with no extra cycle of delay."

  # ---------------- Assertions (irq_ctrl_sva.sv) ----------------
  - id: "A-PARAM"
    kind: "assertion"
    name: "a_upper_bits_zero"
    file: "irq_ctrl_sva.sv"
    proves: ["IRQ-PARAM"]
    description: "Bits N to 31 of ENABLE, MODE and PENDING are always 0, checked under formal and simulation at N=2, 8 and 32."
  - id: "A-RESET"
    kind: "assertion"
    name: "a_reset_clears"
    file: "irq_ctrl_sva.sv"
    proves: ["IRQ-RESET"]
    description: "If rst_n is low at an edge, then after that edge ENABLE, MODE, PENDING and the remembered source level are all 0."
  - id: "A-READ"
    kind: "assertion"
    name: "a_read_no_change"
    file: "irq_ctrl_sva.sv"
    proves: ["IRQ-READ"]
    description: "When we is low at an edge, ENABLE and MODE are unchanged and PENDING changes only by detection; rdata always equals the register selected by addr."
  - id: "A-LEVEL"
    kind: "assertion"
    name: "a_level_sets"
    file: "irq_ctrl_sva.sv"
    proves: ["IRQ-LEVEL"]
    description: "For each source i with MODE[i]==0 and src[i]==1 at an edge (not in reset), PENDING[i] is 1 after that edge."
  - id: "A-EDGE"
    kind: "assertion"
    name: "a_edge_sets_once"
    file: "irq_ctrl_sva.sv"
    proves: ["IRQ-EDGE"]
    description: "For MODE[i]==1, PENDING[i] rises without a write only when src[i] is 1 at this edge and was 0 at the previous edge; it sets after any such edge."
  - id: "A-W1C"
    kind: "assertion"
    name: "a_w1c_never_sets"
    file: "irq_ctrl_sva.sv"
    proves: ["IRQ-W1C"]
    description: "On a PENDING write with no detection, PENDING_next == PENDING & ~wdata[N-1:0]; a write never sets a bit by itself."
  - id: "A-ACK"
    kind: "assertion"
    name: "a_ack_one_bit"
    file: "irq_ctrl_sva.sv"
    proves: ["IRQ-ACK"]
    description: "On a CLAIM write with no detection, only bit wdata[4:0] of PENDING may clear, and nothing changes when wdata[4:0] >= N."
  - id: "A-SET-WINS"
    kind: "assertion"
    name: "a_set_wins"
    file: "irq_ctrl_sva.sv"
    proves: ["IRQ-SET-WINS"]
    description: "If source i is detected at an edge, PENDING[i] is 1 after that edge regardless of a same-edge PENDING or CLAIM write."
  - id: "A-MASK"
    kind: "assertion"
    name: "a_irq_mask"
    file: "irq_ctrl_sva.sv"
    proves: ["IRQ-MASK", "IRQ-LATENCY"]
    description: "irq == |(PENDING & ENABLE) at all times, sampled combinationally."
  - id: "A-PRIORITY"
    kind: "assertion"
    name: "a_irq_id_priority"
    file: "irq_ctrl_sva.sv"
    proves: ["IRQ-PRIORITY", "IRQ-LATENCY"]
    description: "irq_id equals the lowest index i with PENDING[i] & ENABLE[i], and irq_id == 0 when irq is low, at all times."
  - id: "A-CLAIM"
    kind: "assertion"
    name: "a_claim_rdata"
    file: "irq_ctrl_sva.sv"
    proves: ["IRQ-CLAIM"]
    description: "When addr == 3, rdata == {irq, 26'b0, irq_id}."
  - id: "A-DETECT-DISABLED"
    kind: "assertion"
    name: "a_detect_ignores_enable"
    file: "irq_ctrl_sva.sv"
    proves: ["IRQ-DETECT-DISABLED"]
    description: "The level and edge set conditions in a_level_sets and a_edge_sets_once hold with ENABLE[i] == 0, checked by a property that constrains ENABLE[i] low."

# Not yet planned: coverage_point items. They will name the existing RTL design file
# (name not available in the inputs): mode x enable x pending per source, winning source
# per index, ack id in and out of range, same-edge set and clear.
